summary: Consumed the PH-238 planning slot on top of main 3c21a29 (PH-237 delivered by a parallel line as PR #131, PH-210 as PR #132 and PH-232 as PR #133; this branch carries only PH-238). Registered three concrete business slices — PH-239 (cash classification + ledger bridge first slice, ready), PH-240 (refund + bank return within original-cash coverage, proposed), PH-241 (customer-advance Offset first slice, proposed) — each with a frozen spec file covering fields, state machine, permissions, idempotency, amount rules, migrations, exact whitelist, counterexamples, acceptance commands and risk level; added PH-242 as the next independent planning slot (ready, depends on PH-238). PH-239 is registered ready because its dependencies PH-210 and PH-230 are both done on this BASE; PH-240 stays proposed at delivery even though its dependency PH-232 merged as PR #133 on this BASE, because per Lead's division the ready promotion is performed by the PH-242 planning slot; PH-241 stays proposed because it additionally needs PH-239 done. Each proposed task carries its blocker/reason in tasks.json and will be re-evaluated by PH-242. PH-157/PH-158 were deliberately not re-registered as new numbered slices: their canonical specs and proposed tasks already exist; PH-157's upstream is PH-110 (ready, not done) plus PH-142/PH-145/PH-150/PH-155 (proposed), and PH-158's upstream is PH-156/PH-157 (proposed) plus PH-110 (ready, not done), so freezing a slice now would duplicate contract authority; PH-242 carries the slice-evaluation step. No product code, migration, tests or governance-gate change is included, and no PH-237 file is touched by this slice.
